title: App Figma Code Generator Configuration
description: Configuration schema for generating multiple Vue components/views from Figma designs

figmaToken.description: Figma Personal Access Token for API access

useComponentLibrary.description: Global component library to use for UI elements (can be overridden per component)

components.description: Array of component/view definitions to generate from Figma designs

figmaUrls.description: Array of Figma design URLs processed hierarchically. First URL is the primary/high-level file providing base component structure. Subsequent URLs are processed as rows/variants, with each component in those rows being extracted individually. This allows capturing desktop/mobile variants, component states, responsive breakpoints, and theme variations.

name.description: Component or view name in PascalCase

type.description: Type of code to generate: 'component' for reusable components, 'view' for page-level views

useComponentLibrary.description: Component library to use for this specific component (overrides global setting)
